principle: engineering-enterprise-mission graph; configuration-controlled objects and relations

library.purpose: Reusable definitions, vocabularies, types, templates and relation contracts. Definitions are not project state.

graph.purpose: Live domain instances and their typed relationships.

state.purpose: Current configuration and controlled historical states.

evidence.purpose: Append-only evidence and provenance bound to claims/configurations.

work.purpose: Operational intent and unresolved work; never confused with state-of-the-world facts.

inheritance.structural: parent definitions may supply defaults; instances override explicitly
inheritance.authority: never inherited implicitly across domain boundaries
inheritance.evidence: never inherited as proof; children require attributable evidence

semantic_expansion_rules: Prefer new Type_ID or relation subtype over new top-level folder.
Create a child library only when it has reusable vocabulary, independent authority/security, or its own lifecycle.
System families are graph roots, not separate schemas.
A project/programme may reference the same component without duplicating it.
CAD, spreadsheets, code and reports are representations/providers of semantic objects, not the semantic objects themselves.
For sovereign-capacity work, bind BOM, BOP and BOC as separate linked objects; do not collapse materials, processes and operating capabilities into one record.
Shared services, tooling, utilities, qualification and recovery capabilities should be referenced once and linked to all consuming projects rather than duplicated.
The Sovereign Cross-Discipline Capacity whitepaper is a derived review view and never becomes canonical authority.
Candidate discovery does not create a supplier, partner, endorsement, approval or capacity fact.
Outreach presentation is derived from Candidate_ID + discretion + gate state + Lens_ID + evidence ceiling; message style never promotes authority.
Relationship-state changes require attributable engagement receipts; absence of response is not rejection and directory presence is not availability proof.
Temporary M1 bridge revenue must sunset from priority when M1 completes or owner-confirmed funding stability is reached.
Commercial advisory, training and speaking may remain available after M1, but do not become the permanent organising identity of Romer Industries.
Unknown-intelligence/first-contact work remains hypothetical contingency research until independently verifiable evidence exists.
Grant and funding applications are derivative views of canonical technical/business evidence and never become a parallel technical master.
Synthetic market scenarios never promote to real revenue, traction, demand, customer or partner evidence.
Pre-M1 bridge opportunities are triaged A–D; revenue opportunity never overrides protected M1 critical-path capacity by default.
Bridge revenue state advances only from attributable external receipts: lead, qualified, proposal, contracted, invoiced, paid, allocated.
Time-sensitive funding programs require current official-source re-verification and hard eligibility gates before narrative/application drafting.
Manufacturing-support programs must not infer current manufacturer eligibility from planned manufacturing or technology-development intent.

sovereign_capacity_contract.whitepaper_rule: Derived review snapshot only after coverage/provenance/contradiction/evidence-ceiling/external-gate/security-publication/readback parity; never the working master.

collaboration_outreach_contract.candidate_rule: Listing is discovery and planning only. Candidate status does not establish partnership, supplier-of-record status, endorsement, approval, qualified capacity, contracted capacity or availability.

lenses.L06-INDUSTRY-HUB: shared capability-gap, supplier-enablement or matchmaking request

collaboration_outreach_contract.drafting_rule: A bounded draft may be prepared before contact when clearly marked HOLD. Outbound contact or sending is a separate explicit authorised action after gates close and requires provider readback/receipt.
collaboration_outreach_contract.named_person_rule: Prefer verified public routing channels before named individuals unless a specific role, prior relationship or authoritative referral makes direct contact appropriate.
collaboration_outreach_contract.site_custodial_rule: Do not guess or cold-contact an individual Traditional Owner representative. Resolve site/Country and the correct representative body/process first.
collaboration_outreach_contract.relationship_promotion_rule: Advance CANDIDATE to any stronger relationship state only from actual engagement, agreement, qualification or provider evidence attributable to that organisation and scope.

romer_institutional_role_contract.identity_guard: Romer is not permanently redefined as a consultancy, content business, training company, grant vehicle or universal professional authority.
romer_institutional_role_contract.authority_rule: Breadth enables integration and routing; lawful/scientific/professional authority remains with the relevant competent person, institution, regulator or evidence owner.

m1_bridge_commercial_contract.active_condition: M1 incomplete AND owner-confirmed monetary stability not yet reached
m1_bridge_commercial_contract.sunset_condition: M1 COMPLETE OR owner-confirmed angel/institutional funding creates monetary stability
m1_bridge_commercial_contract.after_sunset: Bridge services become OPTIONAL. Existing compatible relationships may continue selectively where they support research, operations or expansion; fee work is no longer a priority dependency.
accept_filter: does not materially delay M1 critical path unless it directly funds/closes an M1 gate
does not create agenda capture or client dependency
m1_bridge_commercial_contract.revenue_evidence_rule: Only attributable external receipts may advance revenue state. Synthetic ROMER30EC market records are scenario data only; proposals and invoices are not paid cash.

opportunity_tiers.A: Prefer — sponsored R&D or paid work directly closing M1/Cognigrex/shared-capability gates.
opportunity_tiers.B: Prefer when low-distraction — high-margin, low-preparation workshops, advisory, speaking or demonstrations with reusable value.
opportunity_tiers.C: High threshold — bespoke consulting only when cash/strategic return clearly exceeds delivery burden and M1 opportunity cost.
opportunity_tiers.D: Reject pre-M1 by default — audience/ad/content treadmill, broad subscription/support obligations, low-margin custom work or business models dependent on engagement addiction.

protected_capacity.rule: Allocate M1/critical R&D capacity first. Bridge delivery draws only from owner-defined residual capacity unless the engagement directly funds or closes a verified M1 gate.
protected_capacity.owner_set: Actual capacity/hours are set by owner/programme state; CGX must not invent availability.

unknown_intelligence_contingency_contrac.rule: Research may explore bias-aware, non-anthropocentric communication and contingency protocols with unknown agents/intelligences. This is not evidence that monitoring or contact is occurring.
epistemic_method: escalate real high-consequence evidence to appropriate scientific, legal, security and international institutions
unknown_intelligence_contingency_contrac.representation_boundary: No founder, company or model may self-appoint as representative of humanity or claim uniquely unbiased authority.
unknown_intelligence_contingency_contrac.commercial_boundary: No sensational, paranormal, cultic, fear-based or certainty-selling monetisation.

priority_logic: earned bridge revenue and owner/angel capital where suitable
R&D Tax Incentive where activities/entity/expenditure are eligible
funding_application_contract.grant_additionality_rule: Funding supports rational project work; the project identity, evidence or technical claims must not be reshaped merely to fit a program.
funding_application_contract.application_rule: GO/CONDITIONAL/HOLD/CLOSED/LATER states come from live program eligibility and project fit. Application drafting is derivative; submission is always a separate explicit owner action.
funding_application_contract.evidence_rule: Synthetic scenario markets are not customer evidence. Partner/candidate names require attributable engagement before being presented as partners or committed contributors.

controls: in-kind support is not unrestricted cash

catalyst_manufacturing_benchmark.trigger: Only when current eligibility is evidenced, including Queensland manufacturing enterprise and program employee threshold.

sustainability_manufacturing_benchmark.trigger: Only when current eligibility and a real manufacturing site/resource baseline exist.
sustainability_manufacturing_benchmark.role: external energy-water-waste-scope1-2 benchmark and action plan
